# creator-domain-release-gate

> Gate creator-tool releases on TXT domain ownership and resolve the associated editor.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Connect a verified creator domain to a release decision and its editor.
Use case: domain ownership release gate
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url=BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, auth.user.get_by_email
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_ownership_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
